change_log.value: Token Expiration and Rotation Core Logic

GPTR-F-002-S51.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract
GPTR-F-002-S51.description: Define the canonical schema for bearer tokens including token_id, issued_at, expires_at, status (active/revoked), and rotation lineage. Implement storage contract in MongoDB or equivalent persistence layer to support lookup and lifecycle operations.
GPTR-F-002-S51.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No persistent token schema or lifecycle fields defined

GPTR-F-002-S52.title: Token Expiration and Rotation Core Logic
GPTR-F-002-S52.description: Implement core logic to enforce token expiration based on expires_at and support token rotation by issuing new tokens while invalidating or superseding prior tokens according to policy.
GPTR-F-002-S52.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: Existing validation does not include expiration or rotation handling

GPTR-F-002-S53.title: Token Validation Middleware Integration
GPTR-F-002-S53.description: Integrate lifecycle-aware token validation into GPTReader request flow, ensuring all incoming requests enforce expiration, revocation, and rotation status before allowing access.
